single.rationale: SharkNinja demonstrates exceptional financial momentum with revenue growing 28% in 2024 and 16% in 2025, operating margins expanding from 8.7% to 14.4%, and strong cash generation. The company holds #1 market positions in U.S. floorcare (Shark) and small kitchen appliances (Ninja), with a proven innovation engine (700+ engineers, 5.8% R&D spend) that repeatedly disrupts categories. At 24.7x P/E with 26% ROE and accelerating profitability, this merits deeper analysis despite competitive and tariff risks.
